items.label: Genset & Standby Power
items.titleEn: Data-centre growth is changing backup-power planning
items.titleZh: 数据中心增长正在改变备用电源规划
items.summaryEn: Data-centre operators are planning for larger and less predictable loads while grid connections can take years. The discussion highlights bridge-to-grid strategies, onsite generation, battery storage and diesel generator sets kept for redundancy. For genset teams, the commercial question is moving from a single product to an integrated reliability plan.
items.summaryZh: 数据中心负载增长更快、波动更大，而电网接入可能需要数年。行业正在讨论过渡供电、现场发电、储能以及用于冗余的柴油发电机组。对机组团队来说，客户需求正从单一产品转向整体可靠性方案。

items.label: International Focus
items.titleEn: World leaders prepare for UN High-level Week 2026
items.titleZh: 各国领导人准备参加2026年联合国大会高级别周
items.summaryEn: The United Nations High-level Week runs from 18 to 28 September, with the General Debate beginning on 22 September. The agenda covers sustainable development, climate action, sea-level rise, pandemic preparedness, peace and equality. It offers practical English for discussing priorities, cooperation and international decision-making.
items.summaryZh: 联合国大会高级别周于9月18日至28日举行，一般性辩论从9月22日开始。议程涵盖可持续发展、气候行动、海平面上升、疫情防范、和平与平等，适合练习“优先事项、合作与国际决策”等商务英语。

items.label: Festival & Culture
items.titleEn: International Day of Peace: language for respectful dialogue
items.titleZh: 国际和平日：练习尊重与对话的表达
items.summaryEn: The International Day of Peace is observed on 21 September and promotes non-violence, dialogue and public awareness. In workplace English, it is a useful prompt for practising respectful disagreement, active listening and language that helps teams find common ground.
items.summaryZh: 国际和平日为每年9月21日，倡导非暴力、对话和公众意识。在职场英语中，这一主题适合练习尊重地表达不同意见、积极倾听以及帮助团队寻找共同点的语言。
